name: Synopsys
verdict: Synopsys, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed US company; its only disclosed owners of more than 5% are Vanguard (7.1%) and BlackRock (6.2%). Nothing found.
note: Partner of the Porsche Formula E Team; Porsche's announcement notes the team's previous partner ANSYS 'is now known as Synopsys' (Synopsys completed its acquisition of Ansys in 2025). Rating note: no state stake and no human-rights finding against Synopsys located.
